name: Project 1: To do list
description: My first project with Cursor was to make a to do list. Users can add to do items and share them with others via email.

name: Project 2: Life Cost Calculator
description: A calculator application that helps users estimate the cost of living in a given location.

name: Project 3: Canadian Tax Optimization Calculator
description: A quick tool to help optimize which tax account to use to maximize tax savings.

name: Project 4: Space bar counter game
description: An interactive game that challenges players to count space bar presses.

name: Project 5: Speed Reading App
description: A minimalist web-based speed reading application with AI-powered comprehension quizzes. Read text one word at a time with adjustable speed and take quizzes to test your comprehension.
